name: Wuclean → Database Cleaner for WooCommerce
author: PayThem

sections.description:
Wuclean scans WooCommerce Products, Orders (HPOS), Coupons, Customers, Images and more to detect items and orphaned data that you might want to delete. Intelligent search patterns ensure precision and safety. Manual review and selective deletion ensure you never lose important data accidentally.

Key Features

📦 Product Cleanup
* Detect missing product meta and orphaned variations
* Detect orphaned product meta, variations, reviews and term relationships
* Detect global product attributes not used by any products

🛒 Order Cleanup (HPOS only)
* Prioritize orphaned orders, guest orders and old orders for deletion
* Detect orphaned HPOS order meta

👥 Customer Cleanup
* Identify fake customers and inactive customers (incl custom roles)
* Detect orphaned usermeta, customer lookup data, comments/reviews

🖼️ Media Library
* Quick Scan detects unused Media Library images
* Unused Media Library images can be protected, trashed and deleted
* Uploads Folder Scan detects images without a Media Library parent

⏱️ Scheduled Actions
* Cleanup completed and failed actions independently
* Trim action scheduler logs

🔧 Other Cleanup
* Trash and delete spam product reviews and comments
* Delete post revisions (keep last X, max age)
* Delete auto-drafts older than X days
* Delete trashed posts/pages older than X days
* Delete expired transients and timeouts
* Detect orphaned postmeta, commentmeta, usermeta and term relationships.

View additional information and details on paythem.net.

Why Choose Wuclean?

  • Smart Detection – Intelligent filtering accurately identifies cleanup opportunities with high confidence
  • Shared Hosting Optimized – Batch processing prevents timeouts on limited resources
  • Coding Standards – Built for WooCommerce following WordPress Coding Standards with proper security measures

Third-party service (Freemius)

This plugin includes the Freemius SDK. Freemius may connect to its servers for software licensing, update checks, and (if you opt in) plugin insights—not to run cleanups remotely; all scanning and deletion run on your site. See the FAQ for Freemius Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links.

Support

Email support can be initiated within the plugin.

Pro Version

Wuclean Pro offers automation, advanced features and bulk operations:

Products: Schedule scans and auto-delete orphaned data, unused attributes and trashed products.
Orders: Automate detection, trashing and deletion of orders, order notes, expired coupons and orphaned order data.
Customers: Auto-detect inactive customers, send custom reactivation emails and auto-delete non-responders.
Images: Advanced Deep Scan and Uploads folder management. Schedule periodic scans.
Scheduled Actions: Automate daily cleanup of WooCommerce Action Scheduler and logs.
Other Cleanup: Automate daily cleanup (expired transients, orphaned meta, revisions, etc.)
sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress plugins screen or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wuclean-database-cleaner-for-woocommerce/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Wuclean in the admin menu
  4. Important: Order cleanup features require HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) to be enabled in WooCommerce as primary storage
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require HPOS?

High-Performance Order Storage needs to be PRIMARY storage for Order Cleanup features. All other modules work without HPOS.

Will this work on shared hosting?

Yes! Wuclean is specifically optimized for shared hosting. Batch processing prevents timeouts on limited resources.

Is data deletion permanent?

Yes, once you delete data, it is permanent. Ensure that you have backups.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version focuses on detection and providing information needed to manually clean items. Pro adds automation and advanced features such as Deep Scan, bulk operations and automatic deletion options.

Does this plugin use an external service?

Yes. Freemius, Inc. is only used for in-plugin licensing features. You may optionally and explicitly opt in—share non-sensitive usage information as described in their policies.

  • Freemius Terms of Use: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
